title: Fras-uben LP Meal Replacement Powder, Low-Protein Formula for Renal Support, with Vitamins & Minerals, Caramel Vanilla Flavour, 400g pack of 1
description: Fras-uben LP Meal Replacement Powder is a specially formulated low-protein nutritional designed to support individuals with renal health requirements. This carefully crafted formula provides a balanced blend of essential vitamins and minerals, making it a convenient and nourishing option for those managing their protein intake as part of a renal support diet. The delightful Caramel Vanilla flavour ensures a pleasant and enjoyable drinking experience, making it easier to maintain consistent nutritional intake. Each pack contains 400g of powder, offering a practical and manageable supply. Simply mix the powder as directed to prepare a smooth, flavourful meal replacement beverage. Whether used as a supplement between meals or as a dietary aid, Fras-uben LP Meal Replacement Powder is a thoughtful choice for those seeking low-protein nutritional support. Please consult your healthcare professional before incorporating this product into your dietary routine.
